_comment: Snapshot of the upstream report's params: block, generated by a workspace build step. Do not edit by hand.

params.description:
Department codes (NeoIPC site codes) whose records are validated; empty =
every department the session can see.
Ids of the validation rules to apply; empty = every rule.
Include the departments flagged as test units.

Path to a validation-exception file (admin-uploaded) naming the records
to keep despite the rule that flags them.

Apply the validation-exception list; false renders without it, and the
report's header says so. Administrators only: the reporting service
refuses false from other callers.

Add an appendix listing the exception records of the departments in
scope that match no record, or match one but exempt nothing.
Administrators only: the reporting service refuses true from other
callers.

When the stored validation-exception list was uploaded, for the report's
header, as yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ in UTC (the same with fractional
seconds, or with an offset from UTC in place of the Z, is read as well).
Server-side override; not exposed via the public API.

DHIS2 endpoint scheme (http or https). Server-side override; not
exposed via the public API.

DHIS2 endpoint hostname. Server-side override; not exposed via the
public API.

DHIS2 endpoint TCP port. Server-side override; not exposed via the
public API.

DHIS2 API path prefix. Server-side override; not exposed via the
public API.

Base URL at which the report's readers reach DHIS2 (http or https, with
the context path if DHIS2 has one), for the Tracker Capture links; empty
= the address the data is read from. Server-side override; not exposed
via the public API.
